title: NOTTO Launches e-Pratyaropan Portal & Mobile App for Organ Donation
summary: Streamlines national organ donation tracking and real-time donor-recipient matching.

blocks.content: Streamlines national organ donation tracking and real-time donor-recipient matching.

items: NOTTO launched **e-Pratyaropan Portal** and mobile app for unified digital organ donation tracking.
Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW).
Implementing Agency: NOTTO (under Directorate General of Health Services / DGHS).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
